text:
英语词汇 · 专四 · 第 55 单元

chance
音标：英 /tʃɑːns/  美 /tʃæns/
n. 机会，际遇；运气，侥幸；可能性
v. 偶然发生；冒……的险
短语：by chance — 偶然；意外地
短语：have a chance — 有机会；有希望
短语：take a chance — vt. 冒险
短语：by any chance — adv. 万一
短语：one more chance — 再来一次；再一个机会
短语：chance on — 偶然发现；巧遇
短语：take the chance — 碰运气；冒风险
短语：stand a chance of — 很有可能，有……的希望
短语：off chance — 不容易有的机会；极小的可能性
短语：stand a chance — 有希望；有可能
短语：chance of a lifetime — 千载难逢的良机
短语：outside chance — 极小的可能性，不大可能的机会
短语：half a chance — 一点点机会
短语：main chance — 获利最大的机会
短语：meet by chance — 萍水相逢；偶然遇见
短语：game of chance — 机会对策；靠技巧取胜的游戏
短语：jump at the chance — 抓住机会
短语：fighting chance — 经过努力奋斗才能获得成功的机会
短语：even chance — 成败机会相等
短语：a dog's chance — 极有限的一点机会[常用于否定句]
例句：There’s always the chance that something will go wrong.
总有可能会出现问题。
例句：If we did move to London, I’d stand a much better chance (= have a much better chance ) of getting a job.
如果我们真的搬到伦敦去，我找到工作的机会就大多了。
例句：There is little chance of her being found alive.
她生还的可能性很小。
例句：(= it is likely that ) you’ll be fine.
你会没事的。

chancellor

例句：Then, when much blood had clogged their chariot-wheels, I would go up and wash them from sweet wells, Even with truths that lie too deep for taint.
因此当大量的血液凝固，阻塞了战车前进的轮之际，我就要起身，用甘甜清澈的井水刷洗猩红，甚至是用深深隐藏在污点后的事实。
例句：When humans first started building things, determining whether they would work as planned was mostly a matter of trial and error. Build a bridge, drive a chariot across it, and see if it collapsed.

typingText:
There’s always the chance that something will go wrong.

If we did move to London, I’d stand a much better chance (= have a much better chance ) of getting a job.
